name: DR. K.M. MOHIBUL KABIR
about: Dr. K. M. Mohibul Kabir joined East Delta University (EDU) as an Associate Professor in the School of Science, Engineering & Technology in September 2022. Previously, he worked as an Assistant Professor in the same school at EDU. He also worked as an Australian Research Council DECRA - Research Fellow and Postdoctoral Fellow in the School of Chemistry, University of New South Wales (UNSW), Sydney, Australia. Dr. Kabir completed his PhD from Center for Advanced Materials & Industrial Chemistry, Department of Applied Chemistry, School of Applied Sciences, RMIT University, Melbourne, Australia, with specialization in micro- and nanoscale acoustic wave gas sensors. He completed his Master of Science and Bachelor of Science (Hons.) in Electrical & Electronic Engineering from Islamic University Technology (IUT), Gazipur, Bangladesh. Dr. Kabir’s current research focus is on acoustic wave-based sensor and high electric field-spectrometer development for important applications such as disease diagnosis, proteomics, forensics, and environmental monitoring. To date, he has published 35 peer-reviewed journal articles in Scopus-indexed journals. name: DR. MOHAMMAD MAHBUBUR RAHMAN
about: Dr. Mohammad Mahbubur Rahman is currently working as an Assistant professor in School of Science, Engineering and technology at East Delta University (EDU), Bangladesh. He is also working as a member of IQAC and External Engagement committee at East Delta University. He received his Ph.D. degree from Queensland University of Technology (Q.U.T.) in 2018. He has earned a good reputation in Physics-based modeling and simulation, Biomedical image processing, and renewable energy through his scholarly, innovative, high-quality research. Dr. Rahman has authored over 38 peer-reviewed articles, including high-quality (Q1) journal papers, peer-reviewed book chapters, and conference papers. His papers have attracted about 1500+ citations with h-index 12 and i10 index 13. He was a member of the team which developed internationally recognized real-world project-based learning (P.B.L.) programs for undergraduate and postgraduate students. This program has made Q.U.T. a world leader in technical education. Dr. Rahman also has experience in Outcome-Based Learning (O.B.E.) and the Blended learning process. He has been a keynote/distinguished speaker at scores of international conferences and invited/keynote speaker in seminars in many reputed universities worldwide. His current research is directed towards mathematical modeling, renewable energy, embedded system engineering, and the Internet of things (IoT). Dr. Rahman also has more than ten years of extensive industry experience in the different sectors, including Healthcare (QLD-Australia), Local government (Australia), aviation, and telecommunication and information technology. He has a reputable, proven track record in deploying and managing cutting-edge Internet of things (IoT) systems, including wireless networks (R.F., LTE, 5G-open RAN) and, smart city systems. name: IMTIAZ AKBER CHOWDHURY
about: Imtiaz Akber Chowdhury joined East Delta University (EDU) as an Assistant Professor in the School of Science, Engineering and Technology (SoSET) in September 2025. Previously, he worked as an Assistant Professor of the Department of EEE at USTC, Chattogram, Bangladesh. Imtiaz received the B.Sc. degree in Electronic and Telecommunication Engineering from International Islamic University Chittagong, Bangladesh in 2014 and M.Sc. degree in Electronic Engineering from Kyung Hee University, Yongin, South Korea in 2020. During his post-graduation, he worked as a Research Assistant in Electronic department at Kyung Hee University where he was involved in several projects related to UAV-assisted communication. His research interest includes unmanned aerial vehicle assisted communication, mm-Wave antenna design for 5G communication, and the Internet of things. Imtiaz has published numerous articles in reputable journals and conferences, sharing his insights on topics ranging from wireless communication to antenna design for 5G technology. name: ASIF NOOR JAMEE
about: Asif Noor Jamee is a Lecturer in the Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering at East Delta University, Chattogram, Bangladesh. He is currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Electrical and Electronic Engineering at Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology (CUET), after completing his Bachelor’s degree in Electrical and Electronic Engineering at Khulna University of Engineering and Technology (KUET). Previously, Asif served as a Lecturer at the Military Institute of Science and Technology (MIST) at the Bangladesh Military Academy (BMA) Campus, Chattogram, where he taught undergraduate courses in Electrical Circuit, Digital Electronics, and Electrical Machines, along with sessional courses in various laboratory settings. His research interests include Perovskite Solar Cells, Semiconductor Material Optimization, and Advanced Renewable Energy Systems. Asif’s research work focuses on optimizing Perovskite Solar Cells and analyzing the performance of Non-Line of Sight communication techniques. He has received the Dean’s Award twice for academic excellence during his undergraduate studies and has actively participated in extracurricular activities, enhancing his leadership and communication skills. Asif is proficient in technical tools such as MATLAB, PSpice, SCAPS, and Microwind, which support his academic and research pursuits. name: ASHRAFUR RAHMAN CHOWDHURY
about: Ashrafur Rahman Chowdhury joined East Delta University (EDU) as a Lecturer in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering under the School of Science, Engineering & Technology in September 2025. He received his Bachelor of Science (Engg.) degree in Software Engineering from Shahjalal University of Science and Technology (SUST), Sylhet, Bangladesh. He is currently pursuing his Master of Science (Engg.) degree in Computer Science and Engineering at Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology (CUET), Chattogram, Bangladesh. His core strengths span problem-solving, object-oriented programming, data structures and algorithms, database management systems, machine learning, deep learning, design patterns, and software architecture. Prior to joining EDU, he served as an Adjunct Lecturer in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at International Islamic University Chittagong (IIUC), Chattogram, Bangladesh. He also worked as a Software Engineer at Orbitax Bangladesh Limited, Dhaka, Bangladesh. His research interests include computer vision, large language models, deep learning, and autonomous systems. name: MD. YEASIN
about: Md. Yeasin is a Lecturer in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at East Delta University, Bangladesh. He completed his B.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering from Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology (CUET). His academic and professional interests span computer networking, cybersecurity, network automation, machine learning, and blockchain-based systems. Prior to joining academia, he worked as a Junior Network & Cybersecurity Engineer at Poridhi.io and gained software engineering experience through internships in ASP.NET MVC development. He has developed projects in networking, artificial intelligence, blockchain, web development, and operating systems, including network automation tools, AI-powered applications, and blockchain-based agricultural supply chain solutions. Md. Yeasin holds several industry certifications, including CCNA, Cisco Network Defense, and Google’s Computer Networking and Cybersecurity certifications. He is passionate about conducting research and developing practical solutions that bridge the gap between academic innovation and real-world applications in networking and cybersecurity.
